channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strike destroys Gaza hospital warehouse
item.description: Israeli strike destroys medical supplies warehouse at Gaza's Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, staff say.

item.title: Iran warns against ‘flames of war’ amid US strike threats on energy sites
item.description: Iranian media says retaliation plan ready after US media suggest potential imminent attacks against civilian sites.

item.title: Trump mimics sound of Patriot missile interceptions
item.description: US President Donald Trump mimicked missile interceptions as he described the US military shooting down Iranian missiles.

item.title: Iran: The Making of a War
item.description: From coup to conflict - how decades of rivalries and miscalculations have shaped one of today’s most dangerous wars.

item.title: Iranian Kurdish parties in Iraq face a delicate balance amid Iran attacks
item.description: Iranian Kurdish groups based in Iraq have been heavily attacked in the war, but most deny US assistance.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis deny plan to charge ships transiting Red Sea
item.description: Houthis say Red Sea route remains free to use, pushing back on report of new shipping fees.

item.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
item.description: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

item.title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
item.description: The renowned mountaineer was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

item.title: Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship
item.description: The attack comes as Moscow escalates deadly ballistic missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

item.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
item.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.
